change_summary: Keep receipt-proven bounded answer-only continuations on one foreground CLI ask, preserve the unchanged user question and Project-bounded handoff, and keep completed server results authoritative when local continuity cache writes are permission-blocked.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill adds receipt-backed foreground answer-only selection, exact CLI syntax, unchanged-question and Project-bounded weak handoffs, profile-neutral transport continuity, and explicit MCP and durable-write countercases.

server_contract.note: The machine-readable contract and MCP schema expose the same foreground trigger, exact answer-only syntax, Project-bounded handoff, result, and counter-boundaries as the canonical Skill.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together because exported source and immutable release assets change as one package family.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI advance together to 0.1.0-beta.37; ask help explains exact bounded foreground continuation syntax, and permission-only local routing-cache failures no longer erase a completed server Question.

help_center.note: English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese guidance explains unchanged-question, Project-bounded weak handoff, receipt-backed CLI continuity, exact answer-only syntax, profile-neutral transport selection, and counter-boundaries.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the synchronized release/revision and carries the unchanged-question, Project-bounded Host decision boundary plus exact answer-only CLI syntax.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the new transport-continuity decision after the existing one-owner read and deterministic-wait protections.

external_marketplaces.note: External marketplace review remains account-owned and is not implied by first-party publication.

public_release_assets.note: Canonical export regenerates both public packages from the reviewed Skill and all referenced modules, including work-model.md, without changing release transport ownership.

release_evidence.note: Contract, CLI, package and localized Help tests cover the receipt-backed trigger, exact CLI grammar, local-cache partial failure, Project-bounded handoff transfer, no-switch countercase, version synchronization and referenced Work Model module.
